case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

reply.text:

move.subject: SH-220: revised commercial package
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your quotation. Offer:DEMO-C1-0 lists €16.00 per shaft; please provide a breakdown of material, machining and logistics costs so we can identify savings.

Could you support the attached package for the 24-month award? Please confirm your earliest achievable lead time and whether consolidated shipments could reduce the delivered price. We would also welcome suggestions for lower-cost manufacturing variants that preserve the specified material and drawing requirements.

Best regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
Please let me explain.
We have carefully evaluated your package and can support the requested DAP delivery and 35-day lead time.
As DAP delivery includes freight costs not present in our initial EXW offer, we can offer a revised price of €16.80 per unit.
In exchange for accommodating these delivery terms, we must request maintaining the payment terms at 45 days.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €16.80 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: SH-220: revised delivered-price packages
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for confirming the delivery arrangements. Offer:DEMO-C1-1 quotes €16.90 per shaft; could you separate the freight allowance from the machining price?

We can increase our proposed price to €14.80 with 60-day payment, or offer 45-day payment at €14.70, as detailed below. Both packages retain DAP delivery and the confirmed lead time.

Could scheduled monthly releases and consolidated transport support either package? Please also identify any process savings that preserve the specified material and drawing requirements.

Best regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
To be fully transparent with you:
We appreciate your revised offer and can reduce our price to €16.70 for the package with 45-day payment terms.
Consolidated transport is already assumed in our calculation, and any process savings, such as doubling the lot size, would require a drawing revision.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
